name: 08008 · Beach Haven, NJ
findings: ZIP 08008 (Beach Haven) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08008 (Beach Haven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
